scope: Translation refinement on top of existing uncommitted trilingual support, usability and field editing changes.

observations: A missing-template warning translates both its wrapper and reason while the authored type label 保存 {0} Ａ stays literal.
Switching the same-origin settings tab from English to Japanese updates a retained template-preview error, group name My 原文 group, duplicate HP draft and template text without saving them.
Invalid JSON stays in the source editor with its unsaved draft intact; its field-loading reason switches fully from Japanese to English.
The empty JSON object shows an object/list-specific field hint in English and Japanese.
The generated Content heading translates while the authored 内容 heading and 保存 field value remain unchanged.
Restoring the source draft to its original bytes returns the editor to the saved indicator without a write request.

runtimeLogs.note: Intentional validation requests returned HTTP 400; neither page exposed warning/error console entries in the captured log view.

limitations: Native archive tests require VIENTO_TEST_ARCHIVE_BINARY; the two existing native groups were skipped.
No Tauri rebuild, installation, native-window retest, commit, push or release version change in this round.
Pre-existing cached layouts require a rebuild to carry the generated-heading marker.
Unknown parser and system diagnostics remain literal.
